stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: Stripe, founded in 2010 by Patrick and John Collison in South San Francisco and Dublin, builds financial infrastructure for the internet. Its APIs let millions of businesses accept payments, manage subscriptions, prevent fraud with Radar, and move money with Connect and Treasury. Valued at $65B+ after its 2024 rounds and processing over $1T annually, Stripe is the default for marketplaces, SaaS and AI startups. In Web3, Stripe's crypto on-ramps and USDC payouts bridge traditional checkout with on-chain treasury. Teams emphasize written clarity, rigorous productcraft and owning money movement that must work every time. In addition to global payments infrastructure, Stripe invests heavily in crypto developer tools, USDC stablecoin settlement rails, and automated merchant payouts.

coinbase.name: Coinbase
coinbase.description: Coinbase, founded in 2012 by Brian Armstrong and Fred Ehrsam in San Francisco, is the largest US-listed crypto exchange (NASDAQ: COIN) with 110M+ verified users and $300B+ quarterly traded volume. Products span retail, Advanced Trade, Wallet self-custody, Base L2 and institutional prime. Public since 2021, Coinbase drives US policy engagement and proof-of-reserves standards. The bar is high for security thinking, regulatory judgment and shipping consumer-grade crypto products. As the premier US-listed digital asset platform, Coinbase sets industry standards for security architecture, regulatory engagement, and developer-first Web3 ecosystem scaling. Coinbase recruits across engineering, risk compliance, product design, and business development to expand compliant Web3 financial services.

okx.name: OKX
okx.description: OKX, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Seychelles with major hubs in Dubai, Hong Kong and San Jose, operates one of the world's largest crypto exchanges and the OKX Wallet/Web3 ecosystem. Beyond spot and derivatives trading, it builds OKX Chain (X Layer), MPC self-custody and DeFi aggregation used by 50M+ users. Backed by consistent top-5 volume, OKX invests heavily in proof-of-reserves, compliance in Europe and the Middle East, and brand partnerships in F1 and football. The company values speed, trading-domain understanding and shipping reliable systems under market volatility. OKX prioritizes zero-knowledge proof-of-reserves transparency, multi-chain Web3 wallet security, and institutional trading liquidity across global markets.

block.name: Block
block.description: Block, Inc., founded in 2009 by Jack Dorsey and Jim McKelvey as Square, builds financial tools around Square, Cash App, Afterpay and TIDAL. Headquartered in Oakland with a distributed workforce, Block serves 56M+ Cash App actives and millions of sellers, processing $200B+ annualized. Its TBD unit builds open developer infrastructure for Bitcoin and Web3, including Bitkey self-custody. The culture emphasizes craft, inclusive design and building systems that expand economic access. Block continues expanding Cash App, TBD decentralized identity protocols, and Bitkey self-custody hardware to make Bitcoin and open financial services accessible to everyone worldwide. Block operates with open-source development practices, publishing decentralized identity specs and supporting Bitcoin core developer grants worldwide.

robinhood.name: Robinhood
robinhood.description: Robinhood, founded in 2013 by Vlad Tenev and Baiju Bhatt in Menlo Park, pioneered commission-free trading for 23M+ funded customers across equities, options, crypto and retirement. Public since 2021 (NASDAQ: HOOD), it expanded into crypto wallets, 24-hour trading and credit products. In Web3, Robinhood offers in-app crypto trading, self-custody wallet and learning rewards. The company values simple, trustworthy product design and responsible access to markets. Robinhood Crypto enables millions of retail investors to trade digital assets seamlessly with zero commission, self-custody wallet connectivity, and regulatory transparency. Robinhood Crypto continues expanding its digital asset ecosystem, introducing staking rewards, international trading availability, and robust wallet security.

bybit.name: Bybit
bybit.description: Bybit, founded in 2018 by Ben Zhou in Dubai, grew into a top-5 derivatives exchange with 30M+ users, known for deep liquidity in perpetuals, options and copy trading. Headquartered in Dubai with hubs in Hong Kong and Singapore, it sponsors F1 and invests in Web3 via Bybit Web3 wallet and Mantle ecosystem. Bybit emphasizes low-latency matching and risk engine reliability during volatility. Expect focus on trading systems, security and 24/7 operational discipline. Bybit delivers institutional-grade derivatives trading, low-latency matching engines, and comprehensive crypto wealth management solutions to millions of traders globally. Bybit prioritizes high availability trading infrastructure, proof-of-reserves transparency, and multi-language client support for digital asset investors.

crypto-com.name: Crypto.com
crypto-com.description: Crypto.com, founded in 2016 in Hong Kong by Kris Marszalek, runs a top-5 exchange and card program serving 100M+ users in 90+ countries, plus DeFi Wallet self-custody and Cronos chain. Known for high-profile marketing and regulatory pushes, it holds licenses in Singapore, France and the UAE. Headquartered in Singapore, Crypto.com invests heavily in security and proof-of-reserves. The pace is fast, global and retail-focused. Crypto.com serves over 80 million customers worldwide, offering retail spot trading, the Crypto.com Visa Card, DeFi wallet solutions, and regulatory compliance. Crypto.com expands global digital asset adoption with low-latency exchange execution, non-custodial wallet infrastructure, and tier-one sports partnerships.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: Kraken, founded in 2011 by Jesse Powell in San Francisco, is one of the oldest regulated crypto exchanges, serving 10M+ clients and 200+ countries with spot, margin, futures and staking, plus a UK FCA-registered and US FinCEN-registered footprint. Privately held, it emphasizes security, proof-of-reserves and 24/7 client support. Kraken also built Kraken Wallet and is expanding in Europe and the Middle East. The culture values crypto conviction, customer focus and operational rigor. Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing and most secure digital asset exchanges, offering deep spot and futures liquidity, staking rewards, and institutional prime services. Kraken maintains rigorous security standards with 24/7 client support, multi-sig cold storage protection, and transparent proof-of-reserves auditing.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.description: Ramp is a financial operations platform for businesses. Its products include corporate cards, expense management, accounts payable, procurement, travel, and accounting automation.

trm-labs.name: TRM Labs
trm-labs.description: TRM Labs, founded in 2018 in San Francisco by Esteban Castaño, provides blockchain intelligence for 45+ regulators and 1,000+ institutions to detect fraud, sanctions and money laundering across 30+ chains. Backed by Tiger Global and Thoma Bravo, TRM traces on-chain activity and builds risk scoring for exchanges, banks and law enforcement. Expect mission-driven work at the intersection of crypto and public safety. TRM Labs equips law enforcement agencies, government bodies, and financial institutions with real-time blockchain intelligence, transaction monitoring, and risk detection software. TRM Labs combines multi-chain data graph analytics with machine learning models to trace stolen funds, identify sanctioned addresses, and prevent financial crimes.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.description: Ripple, founded in 2012 in San Francisco as OpenCoin, builds enterprise blockchain payments via Ripple Payments and the XRP Ledger, a fast, low-cost open network. Lab is distinct from XRP the asset, which it uses for on-demand liquidity. Ripple holds 45B+ XRP in escrow and has fought a landmark SEC case, now focused on cross-border settlement and custody after acquiring Metaco. Rebranded operationally as Offchain Labs for hiring here, the group lists 129 roles across engineering, product, legal and sales in San Francisco, New York, London and Singapore. Expect focus on payments, custody and institutional-grade reliability. Ripple powers real-world enterprise blockchain solutions for financial institutions, offering cross-border payments, digital asset custody, and stablecoin infrastructure powered by the XRP Ledger.

tether.name: Tether
tether.description: Tether, founded in 2014 and operated from the British Virgin Islands, issues USDT — the largest stablecoin with $110B+ in circulation — and related assets EURT, CNHT and XAUT. It underpins most centralized and DeFi settlement and runs substantial US Treasury reserves. The company also backs mining, energy and peer-to-peer projects like Keet. Controversies around transparency have pushed Tether to publish attestations and diversify reserves. Candidates need comfort with high-scale financial infrastructure and operating in a scrutinized, fast-moving stablecoin environment. Tether issues USDT, the world's most widely used stablecoin, bringing digital liquidity, instant cross-border settlement, and financial inclusion to global markets.

drw.name: DRW
drw.description: DRW, founded in 1992 in Chicago, is a diversified proprietary trading firm operating across equities, fixed income, FX, commodities, energy and crypto with offices in North America, Europe and Asia. The firm trades its own capital and is known for technology-driven execution, research culture and autonomy. In digital assets, DRW's Cumberland unit provides institutional liquidity, OTC trading and market-making services. Roles span quantitative research, engineering, trading, operations and compliance in fast-moving global markets.

ajaib-crypto.name: Ajaib Crypto
ajaib-crypto.description: Ajaib Crypto, launched as the dedicated digital asset arm of Indonesian unicorn Ajaib founded in 2018 by Anderson Sumarli and Yada Piyajomkwan in Jakarta, is one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing retail crypto and investment platforms. Licensed and supervised by Bappebti and the Financial Services Authority (OJK), Ajaib Crypto provides millions of Indonesian millennials and Gen-Z investors with instant rupiah on-and-off ramps, spot crypto trading, staking and educational modules. Backed by leading global investors including Ribbit Capital, SoftBank and Horizons Ventures, Ajaib blends consumer-friendly mobile UX with institutional-grade custody and local bank rails. The culture values financial inclusion, mobile productcraft and executing under rigorous local compliance frameworks.

bitgo.name: BitGo
bitgo.description: BitGo, founded in 2013 in Palo Alto by Mike Belshe and Ben Davenport with Will O'Brien and Bill Lee, pioneered multi-signature custody for Bitcoin and built institutional wallet infrastructure now used for qualified custody, hot wallets, self-custody, staking and trading. The company became a qualified custodian with SOC 2 and CCSS certifications and operates WBTC wrapping that connects Bitcoin liquidity to DeFi. Headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota after moving from California in early 2026, with engineering and operations hubs in Palo Alto, New York, Singapore and Dubai, BitGo serves institutional clients including exchanges, custodians and asset managers across many countries. The platform emphasizes threshold signature security, key management and round-the-clock operations. Backed by leading investors, the culture rewards audit discipline, thorough review and building long-term trust for large asset holders.

circle.name: Circle
circle.description: Circle, founded in 2013 in Boston by Jeremy Allaire and Sean Neville, issues USDC — the second-largest regulated stablecoin with $35B+ in circulation — and EURC, plus developer tools for programmable money. With $400B+ USDC on-chain settlement annually and a path to public listing, Circle emphasizes audited reserves and compliance. Its Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol powers native USDC bridging. The mission is to raise global economic prosperity through open financial infrastructure. Circle is the issuer of USDC and EURC, driving transparent, fully backed digital dollar infrastructure and programmable wallet APIs for internet-native commerce. Circle's USDC and EURC stablecoins provide transparent, fully reserve-backed digital dollar rails designed for high-concurrency cross-border transactions.

alpaca.name: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Alpaca, founded in 2015 in San Mateo and Tokyo by Yoshi Yokokawa, offers API-first brokerage for stocks, ETFs and crypto, powering 1,000+ fintechs via Broker API and Trading API. FINRA and SEC registered, it handles fractional shares, shorting and 24/5 trading, processing billions in notional. In Web3, Alpaca enables crypto trading alongside equities for embedded apps. The culture is developer-centric, docs-first and focused on reliable market infrastructure. Alpaca provides developer-first API infrastructure for stock and crypto trading, enabling fintechs and Web3 apps worldwide to embed commission-free investing capabilities. Alpaca enables developers and global neobanks to build customizable trading experiences with multi-currency balance management and real-time execution.

bitdeer.name: Bitdeer
bitdeer.description: Bitdeer, founded in 2021 via Bitmain spin-out led by Jihan Wu and listed on Nasdaq (BTDR), operates proprietary and hosted Bitcoin mining data centers in the US, Norway and Bhutan with 20+ EH/s under management. Singapore-headquartered, it sells cloud hashrate and HPC services. Sustainability is central, with hydro and grid-balancing sites. The work blends data-center operations, hardware lifecycle and power-market optimization. Bitdeer operates state-of-the-art datacenters across North America and Europe, providing transparent hash rate sharing, ASIC server management, and sustainable Bitcoin mining infrastructure. Bitdeer combines high-density datacenter engineering with proprietary cooling technology, offering transparent mining performance analytics to global clients.

sardine.name: Sardine
sardine.description: Sardine, founded in 2020 in San Francisco by Soups Ranjan with co-founders Aditya Goel and Zahid Shaikh, builds real-time fraud and compliance infrastructure for fintech and crypto that combines device, identity and behavior signals with AI risk scoring. Its platform helps hundreds of customers including fintechs and crypto exchanges stop account takeovers and streamline sanctions screening, KYC and transaction monitoring. The team met while building risk systems at Revolut and Coinbase, applying two decades of machine learning experience to financial crime. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Visa, Sardine operates at the intersection of risk, data science and payments. Headquartered in San Francisco with a second hub in Miami and distributed colleagues, the company emphasizes rapid iteration, model accuracy and helping partners scale safely in high-risk verticals.

prime-intellect.name: Prime Intellect
prime-intellect.description: Prime Intellect, founded in 2023 by Vincent Weisser and Johannes Hagemann in San Francisco, builds decentralized artificial intelligence compute infrastructure and open-source foundation model training networks. Its platform aggregates global GPU clusters from data centers, crypto miners and compute providers into a unified distributed network, enabling researchers and builders to train frontier AI models collaboratively without centralized cloud lock-in. Backed by prominent AI and crypto venture funds, Prime Intellect values distributed systems craft, open science and advancing permissionless artificial intelligence infrastructure. By democratizing access to high-performance compute clusters, Prime Intellect lowers the cost of frontier AI training, enabling global research collectives to deploy decentralized foundation models on open protocols.

bitpanda.name: Bitpanda
bitpanda.description: Bitpanda, founded in 2014 in Vienna by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer as Coinimal, is a leading European investment platform offering stocks, exchange-traded funds, crypto and precious metals to millions of users. Regulated under European frameworks and licensed in Austria, the platform emphasizes retail simplicity through savings plans, card spending and portfolio automation. With hubs in Berlin, London and Barcelona and headquarters in Vienna, Bitpanda balances consumer design with strict compliance, segregated custody and educational resources for newcomers. Its business-to-business white-label via Bitpanda Technology Solutions lets banks and fintechs offer trading under their own brand. Backed by leading investors, the culture values product craft, reliable operations and expanding accessible investing across Europe with transparent fees and dedicated support.

hut-8.name: Hut 8
hut-8.description: Hut 8, founded in 2017 in Toronto and Nasdaq-listed (HUT), is a North American energy infrastructure operator for Bitcoin mining and high-performance computing, managing 1,000+ MW across Alberta, Ontario, Texas and New York. Formed from the Hut 8-US Bitcoin Corp merger, it runs self-mining, hosting and HPC verticals. Sustainability and grid services are core, with curtailed energy monetized via compute. The work blends data-center, power and capital operations. Hut 8 is a premier energy infrastructure operator and Bitcoin miner in North America, combining industrial-scale computing, high-performance AI hosting, and digital asset mining. Hut 8 operates industrial energy infrastructure across North America, driving scalable computing capacity for digital asset validation and enterprise workloads.

riot-platforms.name: Riot Platforms
riot-platforms.description: Riot Platforms, founded in 2000 as Bioptix and pivoted to mining, now Nasdaq-listed (RIOT) and headquartered in Castle Rock, Colorado, operates one of the largest US Bitcoin mining fleets with 12+ EH/s and a 700 MW Rockdale, Texas site, plus Kentucky expansion. It emphasizes vertical integration, power strategy and immersion cooling. The work blends industrial operations, power trading and hardware lifecycle management. Riot Platforms operates North America's largest Bitcoin mining facilities, combining large-scale electrical infrastructure, ASIC deployment, and sustainable power strategies. Riot Platforms scales large-scale Bitcoin mining operations in North America, prioritizing energy efficiency, power grid responsiveness, and infrastructure reliability.

polymarket.name: Polymarket
polymarket.description: Polymarket, founded in 2020 in New York by Shayne Coplan, is the leading on-chain prediction market on Polygon, with $2B+ volume in the 2024 US election cycle. Users trade on politics, sports and culture outcomes using USDC, with transparent on-chain settlement via UMA. Backed by Founders Fund, Polymarket demonstrated product-market fit for information markets. The team moves fast, ships experiments and navigates event-driven load spikes. Polymarket is the world's premier decentralized prediction market platform, enabling users to trade on live real-world events, news, and probability markets with transparent on-chain settlement. Polymarket provides liquid, transparent probability markets where global participants express real-time consensus on economic, political, and cultural developments.

bvnk.name: BVNK
bvnk.description: BVNK, founded in 2021 by Donald Jackson, Chris Harmse and Jesse Hemson-Struthers in London, builds stablecoin-powered banking infrastructure for businesses. Its platform offers global payments, treasury and embedded wallets that let companies hold, convert and pay in stablecoins and fiat across numerous currencies with local rails. Licensed and partnered with banks in the UK, EU and US, BVNK serves fintechs, marketplaces and crypto firms needing compliant money movement and yield. Headquartered in London with offices in Cape Town and San Francisco, BVNK processes significant annual volume for enterprise clients. Backed by leading investors including Tiger Global and Citi Ventures, the team bridges banking and crypto. Expect an execution-driven culture focused on payments reliability, regulatory navigation and making stablecoins useful for everyday business finance.

drivewealth.name: DriveWealth
drivewealth.description: DriveWealth, founded in 2012 by Robert Cortright in Jersey City, New Jersey, is a leading B2B financial technology platform that powers embedded investing and digital asset brokerage for fintechs worldwide. Through modern API infrastructure, DriveWealth enables partner institutions—including global neobanks and Web3 finance apps—to offer fractional equities, automated portfolio management and digital asset connectivity seamlessly to retail consumers across more than 150 countries. Backed by Insight Partners, SoftBank and Point72 Ventures, DriveWealth values developer-first API design, high-concurrency order routing and institutional regulatory compliance. DriveWealth's cloud-native API platform enables digital banks, wealth managers, and crypto applications to offer fractional share trading, automated rebalancing, and digital asset custody at scale.

jane-street.name: Jane Street
jane-street.description: Jane Street, founded in 2000 in New York, is a quantitative trading firm and major liquidity provider in equities, ETFs, options and crypto. It trades $20B+ daily with 2,600+ employees across New York, London and Hong Kong, known for deep OCaml and functional programming culture and rigorous research. In Web3, Jane Street trades spot and derivatives on centralized and decentralized venues and invests via its crypto arm. The process stresses mathematics, reasoning under uncertainty and collaborative problem solving over crypto-native background. Jane Street combines quantitative research, cutting-edge market microstructure analysis, and high-concurrency systems engineering to provide continuous liquidity across global digital asset markets.

galaxy-digital.name: Galaxy Digital
galaxy-digital.description: Galaxy Digital, founded in 2018 in New York by Mike Novogratz, is a diversified crypto financial services firm spanning trading, asset management, investment banking and mining. Listed in Toronto (GLXY) with $10B+ AUM and a large OTC desk, Galaxy advised on major mining and protocol deals. New York-headquartered with hubs in London, Hong Kong and San Francisco, it bridges traditional finance and crypto. Expect markets rigor and cross-asset thinking. Galaxy Digital is a leading digital asset and blockchain financial services firm, offering institutional trading, asset management, investment banking, and Bitcoin mining. Galaxy Digital operates across digital asset asset management, principal investments, institutional trading, and Bitcoin infrastructure with full regulatory compliance.

elliptic.name: Elliptic
elliptic.description: Elliptic, founded in 2013 in London by James Smith, Tom Robinson and Adam Joyce, pioneered blockchain analytics for investigations and compliance, serving law enforcement, regulators and exchanges across many chains. Its Holistic screening traces flows through mixers and cross-chain bridges, helping recover funds and meet sanctions obligations with court-admissible evidence. Headquartered in London with hubs in New York and Singapore, Elliptic is trusted for research quality and deep coverage of crypto assets, stablecoins and network entities. Backed by leading investors including Wells Fargo Strategic Capital and SBI, the company emphasizes data accuracy, investigative rigor and helping make crypto safe for mainstream adoption. The team combines data science, law enforcement collaboration and continuous model improvement to surface risky activity early for customers globally.

gomining.name: GoMining
gomining.description: GoMining, established in 2021 in the British Virgin Islands as GMT and operating from Limassol, Cyprus, runs a Bitcoin mining ecosystem that tokenizes hashrate via GoMining NFTs and the GOMINING token. Led by Chief Executive Mark Zalan, the platform connects retail users to industrial data centers without hardware ownership, allowing management of virtual miners, daily rewards and power efficiency inside a mobile app. Hosted capacity spans Texas, Norway and the Middle East through industrial partners, with sustainable power sourcing and transparent reward mechanics. Headquartered in the British Virgin Islands with a major hub in Limassol and a distributed team across Europe and the Middle East, GoMining focuses on gamified mining, clear reporting and lowering barriers to participation while handling hardware procurement, uptime and energy markets for users.

chainalysis.name: Chainalysis
chainalysis.description: Chainalysis, founded in 2014 in New York by Michael Gronager, is the leading blockchain analytics platform used by 1,200+ governments and institutions to investigate crypto crime, comply with sanctions and measure market activity. Covering 15+ chains, its Reactor and KYT products traced flows in major cases. Valued at $8.6B in 2022, Chainalysis is the default for on-chain compliance. The mission centers on building trust in blockchains. Chainalysis provides blockchain data analytics and risk monitoring software trusted by government agencies, financial institutions, and crypto businesses across 70+ countries. Chainalysis empowers public and private sector compliance teams with real-time transaction monitoring, forensic investigations, and regulatory reporting capabilities.

straitsx.name: StraitsX
straitsx.description: StraitsX, founded in 2020 in Singapore as the stablecoin arm of payments company Xfers, issues XSGD and XIDR — the leading regulated Singapore dollar and Indonesian rupiah stablecoins licensed as a Major Payment Institution under Monetary Authority of Singapore oversight. Created by Xfers founders Tianwei Liu and Victor Liew, the platform powers cross-border B2B payments, on-off ramps and DeFi integrations through partnerships with DBS and regional banks. Focused on Southeast Asian compliance and banking rails, StraitsX enables programmable money movement for fintechs and institutions without handling user custody directly. Headquartered in Singapore at Ayer Rajah Crescent, the team bridges traditional finance and on-chain settlement with careful licensing. The culture values regulatory craft, payments reliability and building compliant stablecoin infrastructure for Southeast Asia.

flow-traders.name: Flow Traders
flow-traders.description: Flow Traders, founded in 2004 in Amsterdam and listed on Euronext (FLOW), is a leading global ETP market maker and crypto liquidity provider, trading $100B+ quarterly across equities, fixed income and digital assets. With 600+ employees across Amsterdam, New York, Hong Kong and Singapore, it provides tight spreads for ETFs and crypto ETPs. In Web3, Flow Traders makes markets for spot, perpetuals and tokenized ETFs. The environment is quantitative, low-latency and risk-focused. Flow Traders is a leading global quantitative liquidity provider, using proprietary algorithmic trading strategies to quote continuous bid-ask spreads across digital asset spot and derivative products. Flow Traders delivers continuous electronic liquidity across global digital asset spot and derivative markets, relying on quantitative execution algorithms.

paxos.name: Paxos
paxos.description: Paxos, founded in 2012 as itBit by Charles Cascarilla and Richmond Teo in New York, operates regulated blockchain infrastructure for stablecoins, settlement and custody. As a New York limited-purpose trust company overseen by NYDFS, it issues and custodies Pax Dollar (USDP), PayPal USD (PYUSD) with PayPal, and previously Binance USD, all backed by cash and short-dated Treasuries with monthly attestations. Its enterprise platform also powers brokerage and settlement for PayPal, Interactive Brokers and MercadoLibre. Headquartered in New York with offices in London and Singapore, Paxos emphasizes compliance-first engineering and audit transparency. Backed by leading investors, it focuses on building enduring credible bridges between banks and blockchains today. Expect a culture of regulatory craftsmanship, operational reliability and long-term trust in issuance.

dv-trading.name: DV Trading
dv-trading.description: DV Trading, founded in 2006 in Chicago as DV Group, is a proprietary trading firm active in commodities, equities and crypto via DV Chain, its institutional crypto desk providing liquidity and OTC services. With 400+ employees across Chicago, New York and London, DV combines market making, systematic strategies and venture via DV Crypto. Candidates need strong quantitative reasoning, risk discipline and interest in 24/7 crypto markets. DV Chain and DV Trading deploy proprietary quantitative algorithms and automated market making infrastructure to supply 24/7 liquidity across digital asset markets. DV Trading brings quantitative risk management and deep liquidity provisioning across spot markets, futures exchanges, and decentralized finance protocols.

a16z-crypto.name: a16z crypto
a16z-crypto.description: a16z Crypto is a venture capital fund managed by Andreessen Horowitz that invests in Web3, crypto protocols, and blockchain technology.

merkle-science.name: Merkle Science
merkle-science.description: Merkle Science, founded in 2018 in Singapore by Mriganka Pattnaik with co-founder Nirmal AK, builds blockchain forensics and compliance tools Compass, Tracker and Foresight used by regulators and exchanges to trace illicit flows and meet Travel Rule obligations. The platform covers many chains and decentralized finance protocols, emphasizing behavior-based machine learning over static lists to detect risky wallets and bridge activity. Covering investigative workflows and regulator-grade reporting, Merkle helps compliance teams fulfill know-your-customer and anti-money laundering duties across Asia, Europe and the United States. Headquartered in Singapore with offices in New York and London, the company is backed by leading investors including Kraken Ventures and BECO Capital. The team blends on-chain analysis, law enforcement collaboration and product focus on safer crypto markets globally.

chainlink-labs.name: Chainlink Labs
chainlink-labs.description: Chainlink Labs, originally founded in 2014 in San Francisco as SmartContract.com by Sergey Nazarov and Steve Ellis, builds Chainlink, the industry-standard oracle network for decentralized finance. The network delivers Data Feeds, Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol and Functions that let smart contracts access off-chain data and cross-chain messaging with decentralized validation. Labs stewards research, node operations and enterprise adoption with collaborators including Swift and major banks, handling verifiable compute and staking research. Headquartered as a distributed global team with legal entities in the Cayman Islands and operations in San Francisco and New York, the organization emphasizes cryptographic rigor and reliable infrastructure. The team values open research, node reliability and enabling contracts to consume real-world data securely at global scale for developers everywhere.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: Figure, founded in 2018 by Mike Cagney and June Ou in San Francisco, builds blockchain-native lending and capital markets infrastructure on the Provenance Blockchain. Its flagship products include Figure HELOCs, mortgage and marketplace lending with on-chain securitization that shortens settlement from weeks to days. Having originated substantial home equity and loan volume, Figure pairs consumer fintech distribution with institutional funding rails. The company operates the Provenance ecosystem alongside Figure Markets and Figure Technology Solutions, now headquartered in Reno with hubs in San Francisco and New York. Backed by leading investors and banks, Figure emphasizes responsible lending, auditable rails and efficient credit at scale. Expect a culture that blends fintech execution, regulatory discipline and practical application of blockchain to real-world financial products.

mesh.name: Mesh
mesh.description: Mesh, founded in 2020 in San Francisco by Bam Azizi with co-founder Adam Israel, builds embedded crypto payments and account aggregation via Mesh Connect. The platform enables hundreds of consumer and fintech apps to move assets without exposing keys, offering smart funding and conversion APIs that power transfers inside wallets including PayPal and others. Through a single integration, businesses can connect to hundreds of exchanges and wallets for deposits, payouts and stablecoin settlement with secure multiparty computation. Backed by leading investors including Galaxy, Mesh emphasizes self-custody, security audits and one-click user experience. Headquartered in San Francisco with hubs in New York and distributed remote talent, the team focuses on connecting every account to every app with minimal friction and reliable operations.

bitvavo.name: Bitvavo
bitvavo.description: Bitvavo, founded in 2018 by Tim Baardse, Jelle de Boer and William Boersma in Amsterdam, operates a leading European crypto exchange and brokerage for retail and high-volume traders. Its platform offers spot trading, staking and custody across a broad range of assets with EUR rails, FIX and REST APIs, and institutional custody via Bitvavo Custody. Headquartered in Amsterdam with hubs across the Netherlands, Bitvavo is registered with the Dutch Central Bank as a digital asset service provider and emphasizes fee transparency, orderbook depth and euro liquidity. Serving a broad European retail and professional base, the company focuses on reliable matching, compliance and local support. Backed by growth capital, Bitvavo competes on pricing and reliability. Expect a compliance and execution-focused culture that values platform stability, transparent operations and expanding regulated crypto access in Europe.

blockchain-com.name: Blockchain.com
blockchain-com.description: Blockchain.com, founded in 2011 in Luxembourg and London by Peter Smith, pioneered the first Bitcoin block explorer and now serves 90M+ wallets and institutional trading via an exchange and custody. One of the earliest crypto brands, it has raised $500M+ and remains private. Headquartered in London with hubs in Miami and Vilnius, it spans retail self-custody and OTC.com lists 46 roles in engineering, product and compliance across London, Vilnius and remote. The culture blends crypto-native history with product discipline. Blockchain.com is one of the world's earliest and most trusted crypto platforms, providing self-custody wallets, spot exchange trading, and institutional prime brokerage.

zero-hash.name: Zero Hash
zero-hash.description: Zero Hash, launched in 2017 in Chicago as the settlement subsidiary of Seed CX, provides business-to-business embedded crypto infrastructure for custody, liquidity, staking and settlement via APIs. Seed CX itself was founded in 2015 by Edward Woodford and Brian Liston as a CFTC-registered swap execution facility, later pivoting entirely to the Zero Hash settlement business. Registered with FinCEN and operating with many state licenses, Zero Hash abstracts chain complexity behind a single integration that handles compliance, transfers and reporting. Its platform supports many assets across many chains with continuous risk and compliance monitoring for fintechs including neobanks and brokerages. Headquartered in Chicago with teams in New York and remote, Zero Hash values regulatory rigor, platform reliability and enabling partners to launch crypto products without building infrastructure internally.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Alchemy, founded in 2017 in San Francisco by Nikil Viswanathan and Joe Lau, Stanford classmates and former teaching assistants, is a leading Web3 developer platform providing node infrastructure, Supernode and Notify APIs. The stack powers many top Ethereum applications and handles significant transaction volume for customers including major exchanges and consumer apps, with high uptime and scalable archival data. Valued highly after rapid growth, the company serves developers through reliable APIs, enhanced data and educational programs that reduce need to run nodes directly. Headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York and distributed colleagues, Alchemy invests in developer experience, documentation and enterprise reliability. The culture is engineering-obsessed, docs-first and focused on making every developer a Web3 developer with dependable tooling.

falconx.name: FalconX
falconx.description: FalconX, founded in 2018 in San Mateo by Raghu Yarlagadda and Prabhakar Reddy, is an institutional prime brokerage combining trading, credit and custody for funds, corporates and protocols. Its over-the-counter and derivatives desk provides deep liquidity across many assets with post-trade settlement, treasury management and risk analytics that let clients trade without pre-funding venues. Backed by leading investors including Accel, American Express Ventures and Tiger Global, FalconX holds regulatory registrations in the United States and expands across Asia Pacific. Headquartered in San Mateo with hubs in New York, Bangalore and Malta and a global team, the firm processes significant monthly volume for professional desks. The culture is markets-driven, engineering-focused and centered on institutional reliability, capital efficiency and navigating volatile crypto markets with disciplined risk.

augustus.name: Augustus
augustus.description: Augustus is building a global dollar bank and stablecoin-native financial infrastructure for businesses and institutions that need regulated custody, issuance and treasury rails across borders. The company combines banking partnerships, compliance and on-chain settlement so customers can hold, move and deploy dollar liquidity with modern software rather than legacy correspondent banking alone. Backed by significant venture funding toward its stablecoin-ready banking stack, Augustus hires engineers, operators and product leaders who can ship in regulated environments without slowing innovation. Expect a high-agency culture focused on treasury reliability, regulatory craft and making dollar money movement programmable for the next generation of fintech and crypto-native companies.

grvt.name: GRVT
grvt.description: GRVT, founded in 2022 by Hong Gyu Yea, Aaron Ong and Matthew Quek in Singapore, develops a hybrid exchange that combines centralized orderbook performance with on-chain settlement and privacy. Its platform, GRVT Exchange, offers spot and perpetuals trading with off-chain matching for low latency and zk-based custody that keeps user assets non-custodial while protecting strategy privacy. Headquartered in Singapore with a distributed team across the region, GRVT targets professional traders seeking deep liquidity, self-custody and regulatory readiness without the latency of fully on-chain venues. The exchange operates under offshore licensing with compliance controls and insurance-aware design. Expect a trading and cryptography-focused culture that values execution correctness, risk engineering and building trusted hybrid venues for sophisticated retail and institutional traders daily.

certik.name: CertiK
certik.description: CertiK, founded in 2017 in New York by Ronghui Gu and Zhong Shao, professors at Columbia and Yale, is a leading Web3 security auditor specializing in formal verification, smart contract audits and on-chain monitoring. The company has audited thousands of projects including major layer-1 chains and DeFi protocols, securing significant value via manual review, automated tools and Skynet monitoring. Its suite includes audits, penetration testing, bug bounties and real-time alerts that help developers ship safer contracts. Headquartered in New York with hubs in Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Singapore, CertiK employs security engineers across many countries. The company emphasizes academic rigor, tooling innovation and helping developers understand risks early, combining research on verified systems with practical auditing at scale for everyday builders.

brevan-howard.name: Brevan Howard
brevan-howard.description: Brevan Howard has 6 active roles listed on Hashtag Web3. Current openings include Specialist - Trade Support, 2027 Summer Internship Program - QIS, London, Desktop Support Engineer. Listed locations include Bangalore, London, Geneva.

talos.name: Talos
talos.description: Talos, founded in 2018 in New York by Anton Katz and Ethan Feldman, provides institutional trading infrastructure including order management, portfolio management and request-for-quote connectivity to many exchanges and over-the-counter desks. Its platform centralizes execution, compliance and settlement, serving funds, banks and market makers that route significant monthly volume through a single interface. The system handles algorithmic execution, smart order routing and treasury workflows with low-latency engineering and audited controls. Headquartered in New York with hubs in London, Singapore and Cyprus and a globally distributed team, Talos is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and PayPal Ventures. The culture emphasizes reliable operations, execution quality and enabling institutions to trade crypto at scale with professional tooling and dedicated support globally.

aspora.name: Aspora
aspora.description: Aspora, founded in 2022 and building from hubs in India, the UK, the UAE, Europe and the United States, is a borderless financial platform for people who live and work across countries. Its products combine remittances, multi-currency accounts and card spending with compliance and banking partnerships so diaspora customers can move, hold and spend money with transparent pricing. Backed by investors including Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator and Global Founders Capital, Aspora emphasizes extreme ownership, fast shipping and turning regulatory complexity into simple user experiences. Expect a product- and compliance-heavy culture that values design craft, payments reliability and customer impact across global corridors.

lightspark.name: Lightspark
lightspark.description: Lightspark, founded in 2022 by David Marcus, former Meta Novi lead, with a senior team from Meta, in Los Angeles, builds enterprise infrastructure for Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Its platform, Lightspark Predict and Lightspark Connect, offers node management, liquidity automation, routing optimization and compliant wallet SDKs that let exchanges, neobanks and wallets send instant low-fee bitcoin payments without operating Lightning directly. Headquartered in Los Angeles with hubs in Austin and remote, Lightspark integrates with banking rails, stablecoin issuance and compliance tooling to bring programmable money to mainstream apps. Backed by leading investors, the team applies consumer-scale payments expertise to Bitcoin. Its tools integrate compliance, risk and reporting that let banks launch compliant Lightning wallets, streaming payments and enterprise treasury flows. Expect a product and infrastructure culture that values reliability, regulatory thoughtfulness and extending Bitcoin for everyday global payments.

ondo-finance.name: Ondo Finance
ondo-finance.description: Ondo Finance, founded in 2021 in New York by Nathan Allman, formerly of Goldman Sachs, with co-founder Pinku Surana, leads tokenized Treasuries and yield products including OUSG and USDY, plus development of Ondo Chain for institutional settlement. The platform bridges Wall Street yield to decentralized finance composability through regulated, bankruptcy-remote structures, audited reserves and transparent reporting. Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera, Ondo partners with custodians and liquidity providers to bring institutional-grade assets on-chain. Headquartered in New York with teams in San Francisco and remote, the firm combines traditional structuring expertise with DeFi distribution. The culture focuses on compliant tokenization, careful risk design and building durable institutional partnerships for on-chain capital markets with clear investor protections globally.

coinhako.name: Coinhako
coinhako.description: Coinhako, founded in 2014 by Yusho Liu and Gerry Eng in Singapore, operates a leading licensed crypto exchange for Singapore and the region. Regulated under Singapore's Payment Services Act with a Major Payment Institution license from MAS, it offers spot trading, staking and custody for retail and institutional clients with SGD rails and FAST transfers. Serving millions of verified users, Coinhako emphasizes local compliance, secure cold storage and straightforward mobile onboarding. Headquartered in Singapore with a regional team, it was among the first platforms to receive in-principle approval from MAS and holds additional registrations in ASEAN markets. Backed by leading investors including SBI and Saison, Coinhako focuses on sustainable growth. Expect a compliance-first culture that values operational discipline, customer support and building trusted access to crypto in Singapore.

digital-asset.name: Digital Asset
digital-asset.description: Digital Asset, founded in 2014 in New York by Yuval Rooz, Sunil Hirani and Don Wilson with Shaul Kfir and Eric Saraniecki, builds Canton Network and the Daml smart contract language for regulated financial markets. Canton enables privacy-preserving tokenization of bonds, repos and derivatives where participants share only data necessary to settle, used by firms including Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas and Deutsche Börse. Headquartered in New York with hubs in Zurich, London and Hong Kong, Digital Asset blends Wall Street engineering with Web3 privacy and formal modeling. Backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs and Citigroup, the company focuses on production-grade delivery for capital markets and interoperable networks. The platform supports issuance, clearing and asset servicing with rigorous operational and compliance controls for institutions globally.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.description: Gemini, founded in 2014 in New York by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, is a regulated US crypto exchange and custodian (NYDFS Trust) known for security and compliance, serving retail and institutions with spot, staking and custody. Gemini Custody holds $30B+ in assets and emphasizes SOC 2 and insurance. Headquartered in New York with hubs in London and Singapore, Gemini navigated the 2022 credit cycle to refocus on core exchange. The culture prizes security, regulatory craft and product quality. Gemini is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange and custodian founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, offering secure digital asset trading, Gemini Credit Card rewards, and SOC 2-certified custody.

bullish.name: Bullish
bullish.description: Bullish operates a cryptocurrency exchange focused on institutional trading. Its platform combines spot and derivatives markets with an order book and automated market-making infrastructure.

kalshi.name: Kalshi
kalshi.description: Kalshi is the first federally regulated prediction market and CFTC-regulated exchange in the United States, enabling users to trade directly on real-world event outcomes including economic indicators, regulatory decisions, political elections, and financial metrics. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, and Charles Schwab, Kalshi combines quantitative market microstructure, high-concurrency orderbook execution, and strict regulatory compliance. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, and Charles Schwab, Kalshi operates a regulated exchange where market participants trade directly on economic indicators, inflation rate decisions, political elections, and financial metrics. The platform brings Wall Street quantitative microstructure and high-concurrency orderbook execution to prediction markets under strict CFTC oversight.

0x.name: 0x
0x.description: 0x, founded in 2017 by Will Warren and Amir Bandeali in San Francisco, develops open exchange infrastructure for Ethereum and EVM chains. Its product suite includes 0x Protocol for order settlement, 0x API and Tx Relay for aggregated swap routing and gasless execution, and on-chain RFQ via Periscope that power wallets like Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet and Matcha. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, 0x abstracts liquidity across decentralized exchanges behind a single API that handles routing, slippage and MEV protection for developers. Audited and governed as open infrastructure, 0x emphasizes performance, reliability and economic efficiency. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values routing correctness, developer experience and building invisible exchange rails that make trading feel simple and fair.

notabene.name: Notabene
notabene.description: Notabene, founded in 2020 by Pelle Brændgaard, Ania Lipinska and Andres Dupont with headquarters in New York, provides Travel Rule compliance infrastructure for crypto. Its platform, SafeTransact and dashboard, automates peer VASP discovery, secure data exchange and reconciliation that helps exchanges and wallets meet FATF Travel Rule obligations when transferring assets between institutions. Serving exchanges, custodians and banks across numerous jurisdictions, Notabene handles encrypted identity exchange, Sunrise assessments and reporting without exposing consumer data on-chain. Headquartered in New York with offices in Berlin and Lisbon, Notabene emphasizes interoperability, data privacy and regulator-ready audit trails. Backed by leading investors, it operates as SaaS rather than custody. Expect a compliance and privacy-focused culture that values secure data engineering, regulatory engagement and enabling institutions to transfer assets safely and compliantly.

anchorage-digital.name: Anchorage Digital
anchorage-digital.description: Anchorage Digital, founded in 2017 in San Francisco by Diogo Mónica and Nathan McCauley, is the only federally chartered crypto bank in the United States through Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. regulated by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. Its custody uses biometric authentication and threshold cryptography, supporting custody, staking, trading and governance for institutions without single points of failure. The platform serves funds, corporates and protocols with insured, SOC-audited infrastructure and additional licensing via New York BitLicense and Singapore operations. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs and KKR, Anchorage sets the standard for regulated digital asset banking. Headquartered in San Francisco with hubs in New York, Porto, Singapore and Sioux Falls, the culture blends crypto-native product with bank-grade compliance and risk discipline.

consensys.name: Consensys
consensys.description: Consensys, founded in 2014 by Joseph Lubin, co-founder of Ethereum, in Brooklyn, builds core infrastructure for the Ethereum ecosystem. Its products include MetaMask, the most widely used self-custody wallet serving millions, Infura, the node and API suite powering most dApps, and Linea, a ZK-rollup for scaling. The company also stewards developer tools including Truffle, Besu and Diligence audits for enterprises, governments and protocol teams worldwide. Headquartered in Brooklyn with hubs in London, Paris and globally distributed, Consensys blends product engineering, protocol research and enterprise consulting. Backed by leading investors and enterprise partners, it advances decentralized web standards and ecosystem growth. Expect a mission-driven culture that values Ethereum advocacy, product craftsmanship and building durable, trusted rails for users and developers to access Web3 safely.

squads.name: Squads
squads.description: Squads is the leading smart account and multisig infrastructure on Solana, securing over $10B in assets across major protocols, venture funds, and Web3 enterprises. Through Squads Protocol and Squads Pro, teams manage multisig treasuries, program upgrades, validator staking, and automated permissions with institutional security. Squads is formally verified and trusted as the security standard across the Solana ecosystem. The engineering culture values formal verification, Rust security, and rock-solid UI design. Squads Protocol provides formally verified multisig smart account infrastructure on Solana, securing treasury management, program upgrades, and permissions for top Web3 enterprises. Squads Protocol provides formally verified multisig smart account infrastructure on Solana, securing treasury management, program upgrades, and permissions for top Web3 enterprises.

trust-wallet.name: Trust Wallet
trust-wallet.description: Trust Wallet, originally founded in 2017 by Viktor Radchenko in San Francisco and acquired by Binance in 2018, is a leading self-custody, multichain wallet serving a broad global audience. Supporting numerous chains and a wide range of assets including EVM, Bitcoin, Solana and Cosmos, it offers in-app swaps, staking, WalletConnect and NFT management with no account or custody. Fully non-custodial and open-source, Trust Wallet emphasizes user ownership, security audits and browser extension plus mobile parity. Headquartered with hubs in Dubai and distributed globally under Binance's portfolio but operating independently, Trust Wallet is available in many languages. The product focuses on accessibility for newcomers and power for advanced users. Expect a user-first culture that values simplicity, security education and empowering individuals to manage crypto independently.

fireblocks.name: Fireblocks
fireblocks.description: Fireblocks, founded in 2018 in Tel Aviv and New York by Michael Shaulov, provides institutional MPC custody and settlement for 1,800+ institutions securing $6T+ in transfers across 60+ chains. Its network connects exchanges, custodians and banks without single points of failure. Valued at $8B in 2022, Fireblocks is the default treasury layer for large crypto holders. Expect high bar for cryptography, reliability and enterprise support. Fireblocks powers institutional digital asset operations with MPC self-custody, treasury management, and direct connectivity to 30+ exchanges and DeFi protocols. Fireblocks serves over 1,800 financial institutions, securing trillions in digital asset transactions with hardware-enclosed private key isolation.

mysten-labs.name: Mysten Labs
mysten-labs.description: Mysten Labs, founded in 2021 by Evan Cheng, Sam Blackshear, Adeniyi Abiodun, George Danezis and Kostas Chalkias, former Meta Diem leads, in Palo Alto, builds the infrastructure behind Sui and Move. Originating from Diem and Novi research, Mysten developed the Move language extensions, Narwhal-Bullshark consensus and parallel execution that underpin Sui's object model and low-latency performance. Its product suite also includes DeepBook, Walrus decentralized storage and SuiNS for decentralized identity. Headquartered in Palo Alto with hubs in New York, London and global remote, Mysten is backed by leading investors and bridges academic research with shipping production chains. The team combines systems engineering, cryptography and language design expertise. Expect a high-performance culture centered on research rigor, secure language tooling and delivering reliable, developer-friendly blockchain infrastructure.

complyadvantage.name: ComplyAdvantage
complyadvantage.description: ComplyAdvantage, founded in 2014 in London by Charles Delingpole, provides artificial intelligence-driven financial crime compliance including transaction monitoring, customer screening and risk rating for banks and fintechs. Its platform covers sanctions, politically exposed persons and adverse media across many languages, with real-time screening and mesh onboarding that compares reality against watchlists. Headquartered in London with hubs in New York, Singapore, Lisbon and Cluj-Napoca, ComplyAdvantage is relied upon by many regulated firms seeking to meet anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing obligations. Backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Balderton and Ontario Teachers, the company centers on fighting financial crime with accurate, explainable data, workflow tooling and continuous updates to risk intelligence for compliance teams globally. The platform supports explainable alerts and case management at scale.

moonpay.name: MoonPay
moonpay.description: MoonPay, founded in 2019 in Miami by Ivan Soto-Wright and Victor Faramond with Maximilian Crown, provides crypto on-ramps and NFT checkout infrastructure used by hundreds of partners including wallets and marketplaces. Its widget handles cards, bank transfers and Apple Pay across many countries with know-your-customer and fraud tools that optimize conversion for consumer apps. The platform enables users to buy and sell crypto and collectibles without building payments compliance internally. Backed by leading investors including Tiger Global and Coatue, MoonPay emphasizes partner integration speed, checkout optimization and reliable settlement. Headquartered in Miami with hubs in London, New York and Lisbon and operations in many countries, the company values payments reliability, customer support and making crypto accessible at the point of purchase.

groma.name: Groma
groma.description: Groma is a real estate technology and tokenization platform that enables fractional ownership of residential real estate assets through blockchain rails. By combining property management, automated rental distribution, and digital asset security, Groma democratizes access to institutional-grade real estate investments. Groma tokenizes residential real estate assets on blockchain rails, empowering retail investors with fractional property ownership, automated rent distribution, and property management. By combining transparent property administration, digital asset security, and smart contract distribution, Groma democratizes access to institutional-grade real estate portfolios. Groma tokenizes residential real estate portfolios on public blockchains, enabling fractional ownership, automated rental distributions, and transparent property asset management.

1inch.name: 1inch
1inch.description: 1inch Network (1inch.com) is a leading decentralized exchange (DEX) aggregator and Web3 ecosystem protocol engineered to discover the most efficient swap routes across decentralized liquidity sources. Powered by the 1inch Aggregation Protocol, Limit Order Protocol, and Fusion mode (intent-based gasless swaps), 1inch aggregates liquidity across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, Base, and major Layer 2 networks. With over $400B+ in lifetime trading volume, 1inch offers retail traders, institutions, and Web3 developers deep liquidity, minimal slippage, MEV protection, and high-performance developer APIs.

sei-labs.name: Sei Labs
sei-labs.description: Sei Labs is the core developer of Sei Network, a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain engineered specifically for digital asset trading, DEXs, and high-frequency Web3 applications. Featuring built-in order matching engines, sub-second finality, and parallelized EVM execution (Sei v2), Sei Labs brings Wall Street-grade trading speed to decentralized finance. Built with parallelized execution and specialized consensus mechanics, Sei Network delivers sub-second transaction finality and Wall Street-grade orderbook throughput for high-frequency Web3 trading applications. Sei Labs empowers developers to launch high-performance DEXs, perpetual futures markets, and gaming protocols with native EVM compatibility and built-in matching engines. Sei's architecture optimizes orderbook liquidity, sub-second execution, and high-concurrency smart contract throughput, bringing Wall Street-grade trading infrastructure to the Web3 ecosystem.

animoca-brands.name: Animoca Brands
animoca-brands.description: Animoca Brands, founded in 2014 by Yat Siu in Hong Kong, is a leading Web3 gaming, metaverse and digital property company. Through investments in a broad portfolio of companies and products including The Sandbox, Phantom Galaxies and Mocaverse, it champions digital ownership via NFTs and tokens. The firm operates publishing, advisory and investment arms that help studios launch token economies and marketplaces serving a wide player base. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in Singapore, London and Sydney, Animoca blends game development, IP partnerships and on-chain infrastructure. Backed by leading investors including Temasek and Sequoia China, it advocates for an open metaverse. Expect a creative, entrepreneurial culture that values gaming craft, community ownership and building the infrastructure for an inclusive, player-owned internet today.

xapo-bank.name: Xapo Bank
xapo-bank.description: Xapo Bank, originally founded in 2013 as Xapo by Wences Casares in Palo Alto and now headquartered in Gibraltar, operates a licensed private bank integrating Bitcoin custody with traditional banking. As a Gibraltar-regulated bank and supervised VASP, it offers insured Bitcoin custody in underground vaults, interest on bitcoin and USD accounts with dedicated IBANs, plus card spending. Serving high-net-worth members and institutions globally, Xapo emphasizes security through deep cold storage, multi-party computation and inheritance planning. Licensed in Gibraltar with members across many countries, it bridges private banking discretion with Bitcoin conviction. Backed by leading investors including Greylock and Index, Xapo maintains a selective membership model. Expect a security-first culture that values privacy, long-term custody thinking and combining bank-grade compliance with Bitcoin-native product.

coinflow.name: Coinflow
coinflow.description: Coinflow, founded in 2022 in Chicago by Daniel Lev and Ben Meeder, provides instant settlement for crypto payments through coinflow.cash, converting card and wallet sales into stablecoins with fast finality and chargeback protection. Built for marketplaces and gaming, its products handle know-your-customer checks, fraud screening and global payouts without custodial risk, with support for Solana and EVM checkout. The platform accepts payments in many countries, offering pay-ins, payouts and foreign exchange orchestration that replaces slow bank settlement with stablecoin rails for real-time revenue access. Headquartered in Chicago with hubs in Malta and distributed remote talent, Coinflow is backed by leading investors including Pantera. The team values checkout conversion, risk engineering and helping merchants accept crypto without volatility exposure reliably and securely.

kast.name: Kast
kast.description: Kast, founded in 2024 by a team of former Revolut and neobank operators with hubs in London and Singapore, builds a stablecoin-powered neobank and card for global consumers. Its product offers USD accounts, stablecoin holds and Visa spending with real-time on- and off-ramps, targeting freelancers and remote workers paid in USDC and USDT who need everyday dollar utility. Headquartered with a distributed team across Europe and Asia, Kast emphasizes compliant KYC, local payout rails and transparent fees while handling cross-border settlement behind the scenes. Still early-stage, the company focuses on card issuance, banking partnerships and mobile UX. The product roadmap adds multi-currency accounts, spend analytics and banking partnerships that expand practical utility for globally distributed freelancers and teams. Expect a product and compliance-focused culture that values payments reliability, customer support and making stablecoin dollars practically usable for daily spending.

kamino.name: Kamino
kamino.description: Kamino is an open source credit and liquidity protocol built on Solana.

orderly-network.name: Orderly Network
orderly-network.description: Orderly Network, founded in 2022 by Ran Yi and Terence Ng in collaboration with NEAR and WOO teams, provides an omnichain orderbook and liquidity layer for DeFi trading. Its infrastructure combines an off-chain orderbook for low-latency matching with on-chain settlement vaults across EVM and NEAR chains, letting brokers and dApps share deep liquidity without central custody. Ecosystem DEX frontends built on Orderly serve a high volume of trades with unified cross-chain margin and permissionless builder tooling. Backed by leading investors including Pantera, Orderly emphasizes composability for pro traders. Headquartered with a distributed team and core hubs across the Bahamas, Singapore and remote, the team moves at DeFi speed. Expect a builder-friendly culture focused on performance, risk engineering and empowering developers to launch trading venues quickly.

b2c2.name: B2C2
b2c2.description: B2C2, founded in 2015 by Max Boonen and Flavio Molendini in London, is a leading OTC market maker and single-dealer platform for digital assets. Acquired by SBI Financial Services, B2C2 provides spot, options, CFDs and electronic trading to institutions, exchanges and brokerages with deep liquidity across major pairs and stablecoins. Headquartered in London with hubs in New York, Tokyo and Jersey, B2C2 combines quantitative pricing, 24/7 risk and post-trade settlement that abstracts exchange fragmentation. Regulated as an OTC desk in the UK and expanding in the US and Japan, it serves hundreds of institutional clients. The firm emphasizes tight pricing, inventory discipline and reliable execution during volatility. Expect a markets-driven culture that values quantitative rigor, credit and settlement craft and operating as dependable liquidity rails for sophisticated traders.

coindesk.name: CoinDesk
coindesk.description: CoinDesk is the premier news, media, and data platform covering the global digital asset and Web3 ecosystem. Host of Consensus, the world’s largest Web3 conference, CoinDesk provides authoritative journalism, indices, and market intelligence.

open-standard.name: Open Standard
open-standard.description: Open Standard develops Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin designed as open infrastructure for businesses moving money.

helius.name: Helius
helius.description: Helius, founded in 2022 by Mert Mumtaz, Liam Vovk and Nicolas Pennie in the United States, provides Solana-native developer infrastructure spanning RPC nodes, APIs, webhooks and indexing for high-performance crypto apps. Created during the bear market by former Coinbase and Amazon engineers who met at Queen's University, Helius lets developers build without wrestling with unreliable nodes, complex streaming or costly archival data. Headquartered with a remote-first team distributed across North America, Europe and Asia, it powers staking, validator services and data tooling used throughout the Solana ecosystem. The platform emphasizes low latency, cost efficiency and reliable uptime for DeFi, payments and DePIN workloads. Backed by Haun Ventures and Founders Fund, Helius focuses on Solana-only depth over multichain breadth. Expect an engineering-heavy culture that prizes Solana expertise, performance tuning and responsive support for builders at scale.

taxbit.name: TaxBit
taxbit.description: TaxBit, founded in 2018 by Austin Woodward, Justin Woodward and Mike Hudson in Draper, Utah, develops tax and accounting software for digital assets. Its platform automates transaction aggregation across numerous exchanges and wallets, cost-basis calculation, gains reporting and withholding for enterprises, governments and consumers. Used by the IRS and Big Four accounting partners, TaxBit provides audit-ready records, information reporting and compliance APIs for brokers meeting regulatory obligations. Headquartered in Draper with offices in Seattle and London, TaxBit serves a broad user base through direct and embedded integrations. Backed by leading investors including Haun Ventures and Paradigm, the company sits at the nexus of finance, regulation and crypto. Expect a mission-driven, compliance-focused culture that values accuracy, customer trust and making crypto accounting seamless.

morpho.name: Morpho
morpho.description: Morpho is a decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum and Base that optimizes interest rates for borrowers and lenders by matching supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave. Known for its permissionless Morpho Blue primitives and vault architecture, Morpho prioritizes formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency. Morpho Blue provides permissionless lending primitives that allow risk managers and DeFi protocols to deploy isolated lending markets with customizable collateral parameters and dynamic interest rate curves. Morpho matches supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave, prioritizing formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency.

grayscale.name: Grayscale
grayscale.description: Grayscale, founded in 2013 in New York as a subsidiary of Digital Currency Group, is the world's largest crypto asset manager, offering regulated single-asset trusts and ETFs including GBTC (Bitcoin) and ETHE (Ethereum) alongside dozens of altcoin products. Managing tens of billions in AUM for institutions, advisors and retirement accounts, Grayscale won its landmark 2023 court case against the SEC that paved the way for US spot Bitcoin ETFs. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut with a New York presence, the firm emphasizes regulated access, custody with Coinbase, and institutional research. Expect a compliance-first asset management culture that values fiduciary rigor, regulatory engagement and expanding mainstream crypto allocation channels.

openzeppelin.name: OpenZeppelin
openzeppelin.description: OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015 by Demian Brener and Manuel Araoz in the United States with a globally distributed team, defines the security standard for smart contract development. Its open-source Contracts library is the most widely used collection of audited Solidity primitives for tokens, governance and access control, while its Defender platform and audit practice secure mission-critical systems for leading DeFi protocols and financial institutions. Originally known as Zeppelin and founded in Buenos Aires, the company pioneered formal smart contract audits and education through Ethernaut. Headquartered in the United States with teams across 30+ countries, OpenZeppelin operates as a security-first product and services firm emphasizing research, formal verification and continuous monitoring. Its work underpins a significant share of value secured on Ethereum and L2s. Backed by leading investors, it advances open, reusable standards. Expect a rigorous, audit-minded culture that values code correctness, clear documentation and stewardship of shared infrastructure.

0g-labs.name: 0G Labs
0g-labs.description: 0G Labs, founded in 2023 by Michael Heinrich, Ming Wu, Fan Long and Thomas Yao in San Francisco, builds 0G, a modular decentralized AI chain designed as an operating system for AI. Its stack combines a high-throughput data availability and storage layer with compute and serving infrastructure, including 0G Storage, 0G DA and 0G Serving for inference and model orchestration. The architecture targets verifiable AI workflows, on-chain model deployment and data provenance without centralized intermediaries. Backed by leading investors and incubated with research partners across Web3 and AI, 0G is building toward mainnet with testnet participation and ecosystem grants. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed research and engineering team and Cayman foundation presence, 0G sits at the intersection of cryptography and machine learning. Expect a research-driven culture that values systems engineering, AI openness and shipping performant infrastructure for decentralized intelligence.

plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.description: Plasma, founded in 2024 by Paul Faecks and Christian Angermayer and headquartered in London, builds a high-throughput blockchain purpose-built for stablecoin payments. The network optimizes for low fees, fast finality and native issuance of USDT and other dollar stablecoins, with built-in compliance hooks, fiat ramps and treasury tooling for merchants and fintechs. Anchored to Bitcoin via periodic checkpoints and supporting pBTC, Plasma decouples consensus from payments execution to maintain predictable settlement under load. Headquartered in London with a distributed team across the US and Europe and backing from Founders Fund, Framework Ventures and Bitfinex, the project is advancing toward public mainnet and ecosystem partnerships with wallets and neobanks. Expect an execution-driven culture that values payments reliability, regulatory awareness and making stablecoin settlement as seamless as card processing.

turnkey.name: Turnkey
turnkey.description: Turnkey, founded in 2022 by Bryce Ferguson and Jack Kearney, former Coinbase engineers, in New York, provides low-level wallet infrastructure for developers. Its API abstracts private key generation, signing and policy enforcement into secure, scalable enclaves, letting apps spin up millions of non-custodial wallets with flexible permissions, social recovery and session keys. Used by exchanges, fintechs and on-chain games, Turnkey emphasizes sub-100ms signing, audited cryptography and fine-grained policies without exposing raw keys. Backed by leading investors including Sequoia and Variant, the company focuses on invisible infrastructure that makes crypto UX feel like Web2. Headquartered in New York with a remote US team, Turnkey operates with deep security expertise. Expect a high-trust engineering culture focused on key management rigor, developer experience and reliable operations.

solflare.name: Solflare
solflare.description: Solflare, founded in 2021 by Vidor Gencel and Filip Dragoslavic as a community-built Solana wallet, provides a leading non-custodial wallet for Solana and emerging ecosystems. Available as browser extension, mobile and web, it offers staking, swaps, NFT gallery and Ledger support with direct integration to Solana dApps. Serving a broad user base as one of the original Solana ecosystem wallets, Solflare is non-custodial, audited and focused on Solana-native UX with transaction simulation and phishing warnings. Headquartered with a distributed team across Croatia, Serbia and globally remote, Solflare maintains close collaboration with the Solana Foundation and validator community. Backed by ecosystem grants and community growth, it emphasizes self-sovereignty. Expect a community-driven culture centered on Solana advocacy, security mindfulness and delivering fast, accessible wallet experiences for everyday users.

hedera.name: Hedera
hedera.description:
Hedera is a public distributed ledger technology platform.

Hedera provides a decentralized network for building and deploying applications. It uses a unique consensus algorithm called Hashgraph, which aims to offer fast transaction speeds and low fees. Hedera supports various use cases, including tokenization, decentralized finance, and supply chain management. intellecteu.name: IntellectEU
intellecteu.description: IntellectEU builds technology for digital finance and payment systems. Its work includes financial infrastructure integration and distributed-ledger solutions for businesses and financial institutions.

kappa-lab.name: Kappa Lab
kappa-lab.description: Kappa Lab is a digital asset market maker. It uses proprietary trading infrastructure and algorithms to provide liquidity and pricing across cryptocurrency exchanges and blockchain ecosystems.

legend.name: Legend
legend.description: Legend provides a mobile app for accessing decentralized finance. Users can trade digital assets, borrow, and access onchain yield strategies from the same application.

lisk.name: Lisk
lisk.description: Lisk develops a workspace for businesses managing money across bank accounts, wallets, and stablecoin rails. Its current product brings accounts, payments, portfolios, and approvals together for finance teams.

makina.name: Makina
makina.description: Makina develops DeFi execution and vault infrastructure for onchain strategies. Its platform lets users access yield strategies managed by professional operators and supports asset managers and protocol treasuries.

n1.name: N1
n1.description: N1 develops a layer-one blockchain built for trading. Its network includes native order-book and margining infrastructure, with an exchange offering perpetual futures.

nimbus.name: Nimbus
nimbus.description: Nimbus develops lightweight Ethereum clients for solo stakers and other node operators. Its tools include a consensus client, a verified Web3 proxy, and a Portal client for accessing Ethereum data.

optimism-foundation.name: Optimism Foundation
optimism-foundation.description: The Optimism Foundation supports the Optimism ecosystem and its Ethereum layer-two infrastructure. Optimism's OP Stack provides tools for building customizable layer-two chains and applications.

qcp-capital.name: QCP Capital
qcp-capital.description: QCP provides digital asset trading and investment services for institutional, professional, and accredited investors. Its offerings include spot trading, derivatives, structured solutions, and asset management.

quantstamp.name: Quantstamp
quantstamp.description: Quantstamp provides blockchain and Web3 security services. It reviews smart contracts, layer-one protocols, and web infrastructure and provides incident-response support.

the-better-money-company.name: The Better Money Company
the-better-money-company.description: The Better Money Company builds infrastructure for stablecoin transfers and swaps. Its clearinghouse connects money businesses through a shared endpoint with defined pricing and settlement terms.

trilitech.name: Trilitech
trilitech.description: Trilitech develops technology and applications for the Tezos blockchain. Its team works on core protocol development, application adoption, and support for builders, startups, and artists in the Tezos ecosystem.

usual.name: Usual
usual.description: Usual develops a stablecoin protocol that uses tokenized real-world assets. Its infrastructure connects stablecoin products with governance and mechanisms for distributing value to participants through the USUAL token.

veefriends.name: VeeFriends
veefriends.description: VeeFriends is a character and entertainment brand created by Gary Vaynerchuk. Its universe spans animated series, trading card games, digital collectibles, comics, and physical merchandise.

violet.name: Violet
violet.description: Violet builds blockchain-native identity and compliance infrastructure for DeFi. Its tools include reusable onchain identity signals, anti-money-laundering checks, geofencing, and Sybil-resistance services.

zenledger.name: ZenLedger
zenledger.description: ZenLedger develops tax reporting software for cryptocurrency, DeFi, and NFT transactions. It offers tools for individual investors and tax professionals, alongside enterprise blockchain analytics services.

zircuit.name: Zircuit
zircuit.description: Zircuit develops onchain financial infrastructure and applications. Its products include a finance app with digital asset yield strategies and a liquidity hub for liquid staking and restaking tokens.
